verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Stripe Billing's revenue recognition module (docs-7) and webhooks (docs-16) but contains no mention of native or documented sync to QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, or any ERP/GL system — only generic webhook/API primitives that a team would need to build custom integration on top of. Missing for 10: documented native connectors or partner integrations for QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite, evidence of automated invoice/payment/rev-rec entry sync to a GL, and any customer account of eliminating manual CSV reconciliation.
